description: Backend realtime Part 8 + restart recovery: PresenceTracker with persisted last-seen (new migration), per-user 8-socket cap (close 4003), per-connection PRESENCE_UPDATED with host-only teamPresence, WS auth through Sec-WebSocket-Protocol bearer (query token kept as deprecated), expired-session ERROR before 4001 close, WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL.md updates, and the server-restart/timer/retention/pause/presence/takeover test suites. Depends on FEAT-001 (room-state.ts teamPresence parameter, summary fields). See plan.md decisions 4-9 and items 5-6.
steps: Create backend/src/realtime/presence.ts: PresenceStore interface {load(code): Promise<Record<userId,number>>, touch(code,userId,at)}, MemoryPresenceStore, PostgresPresenceStore(sql) using public.live_room_presence (upsert on conflict (room_code,user_id); failures logged once via an optional logger and swallowed; never blocks callers), and PresenceTracker (per room: userId -> {sockets:number,lastSeenAt}; connect(code,userId), disconnect(code,userId), ensureLoaded(code), snapshot(code) -> teams-independent map, connectedUserIds(code)).

backend/src/realtime/hub.ts: accept an optional PresenceStore in the constructor (default memory); on JOIN_ROOM/REJOIN_ROOM/REQUEST_STATE call tracker.ensureLoaded then register the room on the connection (idempotent: repeated REJOIN must not double count); on socket close decrement and persist lastSeenAt; replace the broadcast PRESENCE_UPDATED with per-connection sends (host connections get teamPresence: [{teamId,userId,managerUsername,connected,lastSeenAt}] built from room.teams + tracker); pass teamPresence to roomState only when the viewer is the host; expose hub.presenceFor(code) for REST; enforce MAX 8 connections per user (close the oldest with code 4003 'Superseded' after sending ERROR reason CONNECTION_SUPERSEDED); in the heartbeat interval and the command path send an ERROR event reason UNAUTHENTICATED message 'Your session expired. Sign in again.' before closing with 4001.
backend/src/modules/rooms/room.routes.ts: make snapshot() use hub.presenceFor(code) for host viewers; summary details use the same presence for connected/lastSeenAt (host only).

backend/src/app.ts: add `presenceStore?` to AppOptions; register @fastify/websocket with options.handleProtocols selecting only 'auction.v1' (return false otherwise); in preValidation for /ws read the token in this order: Authorization Bearer, Sec-WebSocket-Protocol entry starting with 'bearer.' (strip prefix, enforce <=8192), deprecated ?token= query; never log or echo it. backend/src/server.ts: pass new PostgresPresenceStore(managerDb) when managerDb exists (no boot failure if the table is missing).

Create supabase/migrations/20261004090000_live_room_presence.sql: begin; create table if not exists public.live_room_presence (room_code text not null references public.live_room_snapshots(code) on delete cascade, user_id text not null, last_seen_at timestamptz not null default now(), primary key (room_code, user_id)); alter table ... enable row level security; revoke all ... from public, anon, authenticated; grant all ... to service_role; commit; (idempotent, additive, same style as 20261003090000_live_room_snapshots.sql). Do NOT apply it.

Update backend/WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL.md: handshake line (subprotocol auth, deprecated query token), close codes 4001/4003, PRESENCE_UPDATED host variant, ROOM_STATE new fields, duplicate-connection rule, timer-across-restart rule, host policy (no transfer, no auto-pause), idempotent REJOIN_ROOM.

Create backend/tests/restart-recovery.test.ts and backend/tests/presence-reconnect.test.ts with every case listed in plan.md item 6 (restart simulation uses PostgresLiveRoomRepository over FakeLiveSql; a fake PresenceStore/FakeLiveSql extension covers live_room_presence upsert/select statements; assert the captured Fastify log output never contains the token).
acceptance_criteria: A new RoomManager+AuctionEngine+TimerService over the same durable repository restores retention progress, finalized retention (READY_TO_START), live bid state, paused remainingTimeMs, and resolves an overdue lot exactly once
Bids at or after endsAt are rejected with TIMER_EXPIRED; a reused requestId after restart is a duplicate (one bid stored)
Refresh/reconnect/parallel REJOIN_ROOM never changes teams, team ids, sequence, endsAt, status or bid count; a takeover attempt by another user fails
Host receives teamPresence (connected, lastSeenAt) in real time and after restart from the persisted store; non-host never receives it; disconnected teams are not removed
WS handshake works with Sec-WebSocket-Protocol bearer, query token still works, tokens never logged, 9th socket closes the oldest with 4003
tsc --noEmit clean; new tests pass; existing realtime/integration tests unchanged
verification: cd backend; npx vitest run tests/restart-recovery.test.ts tests/presence-reconnect.test.ts tests/continue-rejoin.test.ts tests/realtime-protocol.test.ts tests/integration.test.ts tests/recovery-auth-timers.test.ts tests/retention.test.ts
findings:
Ran: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit` clean; `npx vitest run tests/restart-recovery.test.ts tests/presence-reconnect.test.ts tests/continue-rejoin.test.ts tests/realtime-protocol.test.ts tests/integration.test.ts tests/recovery-auth-timers.test.ts tests/retention.test.ts tests/live-room-repository.test.ts tests/auction.test.ts` -> 145 passed, 1 failed (integration.test.ts skip-voting test = known skip-vote baseline, required 4 vs 3). New: restart-recovery.test.ts 8 tests (retention in progress, finalized READY_TO_START, live lot + duplicate requestId, paused stays paused/host-only resume, overdue lot resolves once + TIMER_EXPIRED, overdue nextPlayerAt, two successive restarts identical, completed/closed rejected + listOngoingForUser) and presence-reconnect.test.ts 12 tests (subprotocol + query auth + token never logged, invalid/expired token, refresh/parallel rejoin unchanged, paused reconnect, forged teamId rejected, outsider/takeover blocked, completed view-only, host-only teamPresence + persisted lastSeenAt across restart, multi-socket counting, 9th socket 4003, PresenceTracker/store failure swallow).
Deviations: added AppOptions.logStream (test log capture) and AppOptions.presenceStore; added optional userId to TeamPresenceEntry; bearer subprotocol without auction.v1 is rejected 400 in preValidation (ws itself only omits the selected protocol); retained picks are not in team.playerIds/spentUnits until FINALIZE_RETENTIONS (tests assert retention.turns/picks instead); the "unconfirmed bid absent" case is covered by rejected-bid/forged-teamId tests (socket-kill race is non-deterministic). FakeLiveSql gained live_room_presence select/upsert statements and a `presence` map. Migration supabase/migrations/20261004090000_live_room_presence.sql written, NOT applied. WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL.md updated.
Payload shapes: PRESENCE_UPDATED payload = {connectedUsers: string[]} for non-host; host gets {connectedUsers, teamPresence: [{teamId, userId, managerUsername, connected, lastSeenAt: number|null}]} (managerUsername = live username || team.managerUsername || ''). Host ROOM_STATE has the same teamPresence array; non-host ROOM_STATE has no teamPresence key. GET /api/rooms/:code/state for host also includes teamPresence. GET /summary: teams[].connected for members; lastSeenAt (number|null) only for host viewer; lastSeenAt loaded from live_room_presence. WS errors: ERROR {reason:'UNAUTHENTICATED', message:'Your session expired. Sign in again.'} then close 4001; ERROR {reason:'CONNECTION_SUPERSEDED'} then close 4003 on the oldest socket when a user opens a 9th (max 8). Handshake: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol 'auction.v1, bearer.<jwt>' (selected protocol is only auction.v1); Authorization header > subprotocol > ?token= (deprecated). Command-path expiry sends the same ERROR + 4001 without processing the command. Out-of-room JOIN/REJOIN before ROOM_STATE: server also sends PRESENCE_UPDATED after each rejoin.
Server: hub.presenceFor(code), hub.hostTeamPresence(room, userId), exported MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_USER=8; PostgresPresenceStore(sql, warn?).setWarn wired in server.ts.
